verdict.rationale: Firebase's own docs describe syncing app data and say Cloud Firestore apps can "listen to" data, even offline. The Emulator Suite docs also name a Realtime Database product. Hands-on community reports corroborate it: one developer built a whiteboard with positions synced live across clients, another added real-time notifications in hours. missing for 10: explicit first-party documentation of the listener/subscription API and how change events reach the UI, and recent independent corroboration (the hands-on reports concern the original Firebase database).
